label: Differentiated squamous epithelium (+ tumor epithelium)
description: Cluster 0 is an epithelial cluster of differentiated squamous/cervical-type epithelium with a mucosal secretory component. The main support is squamous differentiation metagenes M65 (KRT13, KRT4, PPL, SCEL), M69 (CRNN, KLK13, KRT23, CNFN), M28 (PI3, KRT24, TGM1, IVL) and M18 (KRT24, KLK10, TGM1), plus glandular/mucosal M20 (MUC1, CEACAM7, TMPRSS2, PSCA) and tumor epithelial M42 (PLAT, SERPINB4). Basal markers KRT5/KRT14 are absent, so the cluster is mostly suprabasal. Top genes CRNN, KLK13, CLCA4, PI3, KLK10, MUC21 and MUC1 are consistent. S100A8/S100A9 (M0, M28) are shared with neutrophil or inflamed mucosa and are not treated as a separate lineage; the signal is weak in most cells and not a clear mixture.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells, Glandular epithelial cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Glandular secretory epithelium program

label: Low-quality cells, weak squamous signal (technical)
description: Cluster 1 (580 cells) has no clear lineage. Its largest shares come from technical or ambiguous metagenes: M30 (OR4F17/IST1, 14.9%, in 43% of cells), M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4 multi-copy genes, 11.7%), and M45, M51, M61 and M56, which are diffuse background-like factors. The top genes (OR4F17, IST1, SAT1, ERO1A, SIGLEC15, TRIM49D1, PGA3) are probe or multi-mapping artifacts or generic stress genes. The only lineage-like signal is weak: squamous differentiation M37 (1.6%), basal-like squamous M10 (1.5%) and myeloid M14 (1.9%), each in fewer than 7% of cells. This pattern suggests a low-quality cluster, with at most weak squamous epithelial signal.

label: Regulatory T cells (CD8 T subset)
description: Cluster 2 is a T-cell cluster. The T-lineage metagene M29 (CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, CD2, CD247, BCL11B) is present in 57% of cells, and the regulatory T-cell metagene M83 (FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT) is enriched at 39.7x, so the cluster leans toward Tregs. The CD8 cytotoxic metagene M93 (CD8A, CD8B, CST7, GZMK, PRF1) is present in about a quarter of cells, indicating a CD8 subset. Foreign signal is minimal: the stromal metagene M75 is 1.8% and the rest is diffuse, nonlineage background.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD8 T cells, CD4 T cells
metagene_label: T cell markers + Regulatory T cell markers

label: Squamous epithelium, inflamed and hypoxic (differentiated)
description: Cluster 3 is a keratinizing squamous epithelial population, most likely differentiated tumor or cervical epithelium. M37 (18.8% share, 78.9x fold, in 56% of cells) carries the cornification genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL and SCEL, and M15 adds terminal differentiation genes (IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP). M11 hypoxia (10.7%) and inflammatory S100A8/S100A9 weight (M0, M37) make the state inflamed and hypoxic. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent, so the cluster leans toward superficial rather than basal cells. No separate foreign lineage metagene is listed, so no contamination is called.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Keratinocytes, Tumor epithelial cells

label: Fibroblasts (smooth muscle-like stroma)
description: Weak stromal signal: M4 (fibroblast ECM, SFRP4, COL3A1, PDGFRA) and M19 (smooth muscle/perivascular myofibroblast, DES, MYH11, TAGLN, CCN2) are the lineage metagenes, each at about 4% share with 1.8x and 2.6x fold. M75 (stromal stress state, C7, DPT, RSPO3) adds a little. Most of the cluster's counts come from diffuse housekeeping background (M64, M58, M43, M95, NPM1/GNAS/TPT1), and the top genes are largely housekeeping, with SFRP4 and CCN2 the only clear stromal genes. Since M4 peaks in cluster 33, this cluster is a low-purity stromal population, probably fibroblasts with a smooth-muscle-like component. No immune or epithelial contamination is evident.
refine_reason: Same smooth muscle-like fibroblast identity as cluster 37; wording aligned to the shared phrasing.

label: B cells (germinal center subset)
description: Cluster 5 is B lymphocytes, consistent with lymphoid aggregates in cervical tumor. M34 (B cell markers: MS4A1, BANK1, BLK, CD79A, CD22, FCRL1, TNFRSF13C, IRF8) carries 16.5% of counts and is present in about 81% of cells, and the top genes are dominated by the same B-cell markers (MS4A1, CD22, BANK1, BLK, CD79A). M33 (germinal-center program: CXCL13, CR2, GCSAM, AICDA, RGS13, FCER2) adds 6.4% in about 13% of cells, so a germinal-center subset is present within the B-cell population. M14 (myeloid, 2.0%, fold 1.1x) and the diffuse M79, M8 and M13 are background or unresolved, not a contaminating lineage, so no contamination is called.
cell_types: B cells, Germinal center B cells

label: Squamous epithelial cells (differentiated, S100A8/A9-high)
description: Squamous epithelial cells, most likely differentiated or suprabasal cervical epithelium or tumor cells. The cluster is driven by squamous metagenes M0, M5 and M6 (top genes PERP, KRT13, DSP, DSG3, CD24, SERPINB13, KRT5), with a basal add-on from M26 and M1. S100A8/S100A9 are high in M0 but are not carried by a separate myeloid metagene, so no contamination is called. Ambiguous diffuse metagenes M12 and M55 add epithelial-leaning background.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Cervical carcinoma cells
metagene_label: Differentiated squamous epithelium, S100A8/A9-high + Squamous epithelium, KRT13/DSP-high

label: Activated fibroblasts (smooth muscle-like stroma)
description: Cluster 7 is dominated by fibroblast/stromal signal: M4 (fibroblast ECM core, 18.5% share, present in 70% of cells) and M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma, 13.8%) together with M38 (activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, 6.1%). Top genes (SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1, CCN2, COL6A1, COL5A1, TAGLN, GREM1, LUM) confirm a fibroblast-rich stromal identity with some smooth muscle-like and activated states. Remaining metagenes (M56, M95, M60, M63, M84, M64, M62, M92, M90) are diffuse housekeeping or background factors with no lineage, and no immune or epithelial contamination is evident.
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Endothelial cells (+ pericyte signal)
description: Cluster is dominated by vascular endothelial signal: M27 (22.2% share, in 66% of cells, >100x fold) with top genes VWF, PECAM1, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1, KDR and MMRN1. M25 (18.1% share, in 72% of cells, 72x fold) carries pericyte-like NOTCH3/RGS5/CSPG4 signal in most cells, but its canonical pericyte genes are not among the top genes, so it is treated as a substantial mural co-signal or spillover rather than the cluster's own identity. Fibroblast (M4, M38) and other stromal metagenes are minor.

label: Low-quality stromal-leaning cells (technical signal)
description: Cluster 9 is dominated by diffuse, low-specificity metagenes with no coherent lineage: M30 (OR4F17/IST1-high, 13.1%), M2 (SIGLEC15/GOLGA6L4-high, 10.4%), and several nuclear/RNA-processing factors (M45, M60, M8). Weak stromal signal is present in about 11% of cells: fibroblast ECM M4 (3.2%, fold 1.4x), smooth muscle/myofibroblast M19 (2.6%), and endothelial M27 (1.3%, fold 2.2x). Top genes are mostly junk-like (OR4F17, IST1, SIGLEC15, SMG1, PDE4DIP) with no clear canonical lineage markers, so the cluster is probably low-quality stromal-leaning cells rather than a defined population.

label: Ambiguous, weak squamous epithelium signal
description: Cluster 10 is a weakly defined cluster with no clear lineage. The only epithelial-leaning metagene is M10 (basal-like squamous, KRT15/ITGA2/DSC3, 2.1% share, 4.1% of cells), and its key basal genes KRT5, KRT14 and KRT17 do not load here. The composition is dominated by diffuse, low-specificity factors (M45, M30, M2, M56, M22, M60) with nuclear RNA-processing, splicing and multi-copy gene signals (OR4F17, IST1, SMG1, ZNG1A, SIGLEC15), and no coherent cell-type signature stands out among the top genes. The weak TP63/ITGB4 signal in M74 (3.7%) gives only partial support for squamous epithelium, so the cluster is best treated as low-quality or ambiguous rather than a confident epithelial population.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Unclear low-quality cells

label: T cells (+ stromal signal)
description: Low-signal cluster whose best-supported identity is T lymphocytes: M29 (T cell markers, 3.3%, in 28% of cells, 2.9x) leads the lineage metagenes, with M83 (Treg, 2.3%) and M93 (CD8/NK cytotoxic, 1.8%) adding subsets. Top enriched genes (TRAC, CD3E, GIMAP7, GIMAP4, CD52, ETS1) are T-lineage. Stromal signal is a foreign component of about 10%, mainly fibroblast ECM M4 (3.8%) and smooth muscle M19 (3.6%), with smaller endothelial M27 (1.2%) that is likely spillover or contamination. Technical and ambiguous metagenes (M30, M2, M8) make up about 18% and carry no identity.
cell_types: T cells, Regulatory T cells, CD8 T cells

label: Squamous epithelial cells (NF-kB inflammatory, low quality)
description: Weakly defined cluster with a squamous epithelial signal: M0 (differentiated squamous, S100A8/A9-high, 1.6x enriched) and M15 (cornification genes, IVL among the top genes, 2.5x) point to squamous epithelium, supported by M5 (DSP/KRT13). Most of the modeled counts come from technical or diffuse metagenes (M30 OR4F17/IST1, M2) and an NF-kB/TNF inflammatory response (M36, M35), which do not define a lineage. No clear contaminating lineage is listed. Confidence is low.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (hypoxic, differentiated)
description: Small cluster of squamous epithelial cells. M6 (squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes, 25% of counts) leads, with SERPINB13, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2 and NECTIN4 among the top genes. Basal keratinocyte factors M26 (12.6%) and M80 (7.9%), with TP63, KRT15 and CYP24A1, add a basal-like component. M20 (glandular secretory, 5%) adds a minor epithelial component, consistent with the same epithelium. Non-epithelial signal is minor; no clear foreign lineage is supported.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation with hypoxia genes + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Activated fibroblasts, ECM-remodeling
description: Cluster 14 is a small stromal cluster of about 45 cells, best called fibroblasts. M4 (fibroblast ECM, 11.5% share, 5.1x fold) carries the top genes COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1, COL6A2, COL5A1, TNC, LUM and AEBP1, with no endothelial or immune markers. M38 (activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, 2.5%) and M19 (smooth muscle/myofibroblast stroma, 3.8%) add a minor activated or perivascular-like component. The large technical and ambiguous shares (M30, M2) carry no lineage. Foreign lineage signals (plasma cell M3, CD8 M93, squamous M37) are each at or under about 2%, so they are background and not listed as contaminants.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Cancer-associated fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells
refine_reason: Same activated ECM-remodeling fibroblast identity as clusters 33, 46 and 49; wording standardized.

label: Fibroblasts (low-quality, diffuse signal)
description: Tiny, low-signal cluster (36 cells) whose only substantive lineage signal is a fibroblast ECM program: M4 (7.0% share, in 11% of cells, 3.1x fold) with SFRP4, COL3A1, SFRP1 and COL6A1 among the top genes. Endothelial (M27, 4.0%) and Treg (M83, 4.2%) metagenes are each small, sparse and below the contamination threshold, so they are background. Most of the counts come from diffuse housekeeping, ER-secretory, NPM1/IFNGR1 and nuclear metagenes (M77, M97, M50), so the identity rests on weak evidence and the cluster may be low quality.
cell_types: Fibroblasts, Endothelial cells, Regulatory T cells
metagene_label: ER protein translocation and glycosylation + NPM1/SMC1A/MED14-high

label: Basal squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 16 is squamous epithelial, with a basal/reserve-like profile. The main support is M1 (basal squamous epithelium, 9.1%), with M26 (basal keratinocyte program, 6.1%), M10 (KRT15 basal-like, 5.6%), M80 (basal state, 4.8%) and M5 (squamous KRT13/DSP, 2.8%). The top genes KRT15, TP63, ITGB4, ITGA2, LAMB3, COL7A1 and CYP24A1 agree. Cycling (M17, 3.1%) and other programs are minor, and no immune, stromal or other foreign lineage metagene is substantial, so no contamination is called. Many diffuse ambiguous metagenes carry the remainder of the counts without lineage meaning. KRT14 and KRT5 are only partly captured, so the squamous subtype is less certain than the epithelial identity.
cell_types: Basal squamous epithelial cells, Squamous epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells
metagene_label: Basal squamous epithelial cells + Basal keratinocyte program

label: Glandular secretory epithelial cells (+ fibroblast signal)
description: Small, low-coherence cluster of 24 cells. The strongest lineage signal is the glandular secretory epithelium module M20 (6.2% share, present in 33% of cells, 7.7x fold), supported by MUC1, CEACAM7, LYPD2, TMPRSS2 and PSCA, with mucinous tumor epithelial M54 (3.5%) as a secondary epithelial signal. Stromal signal is substantial: fibroblast ECM M4 (5.2%, 2.3x) and activated fibroblast M38 (3.7%) with collagens COL3A1 and COL6A1 among the top genes, which is roughly 9% and likely contamination or doublet signal in a minority of cells. Endothelial M27 (1.7%) and B-cell M34 (2.2%) are small and treated as background. Technical/diffuse metagenes (M2, M30, M68, OR4F17) dominate the remainder and do not define identity.
cell_types: Glandular epithelial cells, Tumor epithelial cells, Fibroblasts
metagene_label: Glandular secretory epithelium program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Cycling squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 18 is dominated by proliferation programs: the histone/mitotic metagene M7 (8.5%), the S-phase metagene M17 (7.3%), and the G2/M metagenes M39, M24 and M41 together make up roughly 23% of counts, and the top genes are histone, TOP2A, MKI67, TPX2, BIRC5 and CENPF. The squamous lineage is the best candidate for the cells' identity: basal squamous M1 (6.0%, KRT5/TP63/DSP, 2.2x) and the squamous add-on M5 (3.3%) are present, with M74 (TP63/ITGB4) weakly supporting it. The lineage signal is modest and the top genes lack classic keratins, so the cycling cells are probably squamous/tumor epithelial cells but this is not firmly established. No meaningful foreign lineage is present; S100A8/A9 signal in M12 is small.
cell_types: Cycling squamous epithelial cells, Cycling tumor cells
metagene_label: Cycling cells, histone and mitotic genes + S-phase DNA replication program

label: Regulatory T cells (CD4 Treg)
description: Cluster is dominated by T-lineage signal: M83 (Treg markers FOXP3, CTLA4, IL2RA, ICOS, TIGIT) carries 7.2% of counts, with M29 (CD3E, TRAC, TRBC2, BCL11B) at 3.3% and M93 (CD8/cytotoxic) at 1.6%. Top genes CTLA4, TRAC, CD3E, TRBC1 and TRBC2 agree, pointing to regulatory CD4 T cells. Fibroblast (M4, 3.0%) and myeloid (M14, 2.2%) signals are small, background-level contamination and are not called.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells, T cells

label: Tumor-associated macrophages (myeloid)
description: Myeloid cluster dominated by macrophage signal: M59 (tumor-associated macrophages, 7.8% share, C1QA/C1QC, APOE, SPP1, CD163, MMP9, CD14) and M14 (myeloid, CLEC10A/FCGR2A/CSF1R/FGL2, 22.1% share, present in 80% of cells). Top genes (C1QA, C1QC, MMP9, APOE, CD14, CSF1R, STAB1, FCER1G) are strongly enriched, supporting a macrophage-dominant identity with a monocyte/dendritic-like myeloid component. Epithelial signal (M1, 1.8%) and the other metagenes are negligible background.

label: Fibroblasts (IFN-gamma response, endothelial signal)
description: Cluster of 34 cells whose stromal identity rests on the fibroblast ECM factor M4 (6.5%, collagens COL3A1/COL6A1/COL6A2/COL5A1, SFRP4) and the activated-fibroblast factor M38 (5.1%, COL3A1, POSTN, INHBA, MMP11), together about 12% of counts. The largest share of counts, however, is the IFN-gamma response program M49 (8.7%, 16x enriched; top genes CXCL10, CXCL9, STAT1, TAP1, GBP1, IDO1), which is a program and does not define a lineage. Endothelial M27 (6.0%, VWF, EGFL7, RAMP2, FLT1) is a moderate foreign signal, mostly from cluster 8, and is listed as contamination. CD8 cytotoxic M93 (3.7%, in 11.8% of cells) is minor background.
metagene_label: IFN-gamma response program + Fibroblast ECM markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (inflamed)
description: Small cluster (36 cells) whose identity is squamous epithelium. Squamous differentiation metagenes M37 (6.0%, fold 9.2x, with CRNN, CRCT1, FLG, IVL, KRT13) and M0 (4.3%, KRT13, KRT4, CD24, DSC2) lead, with M70 adding mucosal squamous genes. The top modeled genes CRNN, ERO1A, ECM1, CTNND1 and EMP1 agree. The inflammatory S100A8/A9 and hypoxia components give an inflamed, superficial state. Basal markers are absent. The macrophage metagene M59 (3.1%, in 8.3% of cells) is a minor foreign signal under 5%, so it is background and not listed as contamination. Proliferation (M17, 7.5%) and large ambiguous background factors (M45, M64) do not define identity.

label: Fibroblast/macrophage mixture (plasma cell signal)
description: Small, heterogeneous cluster with no lineage carrying most of its cells. Fibroblast ECM metagene M4 (10.1% share, 4.5x fold) and tumor-associated macrophage metagene M59 (7.3%, 11.6x fold) are the largest lineage shares, with the top genes COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1, MMP9, C1QA and APOE. IgG plasma cell metagene M3 (2.1%, with IGHG1 as the single largest gene at 1.04%) and T cell metagene M29 (3.8%) add signal, and both are confined to a few cells, which suggests doublets or spillover. The diffuse background factors M58 and M64 account for about a quarter of counts and carry no identity.

label: Fibroblasts (minor CD8 T cell signal)
description: Cluster 24 is a small group of 39 cells whose clearest identity is fibroblast. M4 (fibroblast ECM, 11.2% share, 5.0x enriched) is the largest metagene, and the top genes agree: COL3A1, SFRP1, SFRP4, COL6A1/2, TNC, COL5A1. The fibroblast share is modest and many diffuse metagenes (M58, M40, M9, M95) take the rest, so the call is medium confidence. M93 (CD8 cytotoxic T/NK, 5.4% share, 9.8x enriched, in only 2.6% of cells, about one cell) with CD8A and CST7 among the top genes is likely a lymphocyte doublet or spillover in a single cell rather than a true T-cell population. M29 (T cell markers, 4.2%) and M34 (B cell markers, 2.7%) are small, so they are treated as background.

label: Plasma cells (IgG-high, ER stress-active)
description: Cluster 25 is dominated by plasma cell signatures: M3 (IgG plasma cell markers, 14.1% share, present in 54% of cells) and M31 (plasma cell immunoglobulin program, 5.8%) together with M23 (IgG plasma cell, 1.8%), with top genes IGHG1, IGHG2, IGKC, IGHG3, IGLC7, MZB1, XBP1, DERL3 and POU2AF1 all strongly enriched over other cells. The ER stress/UPR program M53 (24.9% share, 80% of cells) is a secretory-activity factor that accompanies the plasma cell identity rather than defining a separate lineage. Fibroblast (M4, 3.1%) and B/T lymphocyte signals are minor and absent from the top genes, so no meaningful contamination is called. The remaining metagenes (M8, M79, M60, M13, M77) are diffuse and low-share background.
metagene_label: ER stress unfolded protein response + IgG plasma cell markers

label: Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma
description: Stromal cluster dominated by smooth-muscle/myofibroblast-like and fibroblast ECM programs: M19 (DES, ACTG2, MYH11, TAGLN, MYLK, CCN2, SFRP4) holds 13.9% of counts with 9.2x enrichment, and M4 (COL3A1, COL6A1, SFRP1, LUM) and M38 (POSTN, INHBA, MMP11, THBS2) add fibroblast and activated-stroma signal. Top genes (MYH9, CCN2, SFRP4, COL3A1, TAGLN, THBS1, GREM1, COL5A1) agree. M29 T-cell markers (CD3E, TRAC, CD2) reach 7.4% in only about 2 of 35 cells, which suggests T-cell doublets or spillover rather than a T-cell identity, and epithelial signal (M69, M28) is minor.
metagene_label: Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma + T cell markers

label: Inflamed squamous epithelial cells (NF-kB high)
description: A small, low-confidence cluster (50 cells). The largest share is the diffuse NF-kB/TNF program M36 (12.3%, TNFAIP2 top gene), which has no lineage. The lineage signal leans squamous: M69 (CRNN-high differentiated squamous), M37 (squamous differentiation, inflamed) and M5 together make up about 9%, and CRNN is among the top genes at 4.5x fold. Immune signal is modest (M29 T cell 4.0%, M93 CD8 cytotoxic 2.0%, about 6% combined), and stromal signal is modest (M38 and M75, about 5%). These are likely contamination or doublet signal, not the cluster's own identity. The cluster's own identity is therefore uncertain, with a squamous epithelial lean.

label: Fibroblasts, activated ECM (+ plasma cell signal)
description: Cluster 28 is a small fibroblast-dominated cluster: M4 (fibroblast ECM markers, 41.4% share, in 81.5% of cells) and M38 (activated/cancer-associated fibroblast ECM state, 21.2%) together make up about 63% of counts, with top genes COL3A1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2, COL1A2, SFRP1/4, LUM, TNC, MMP11 and POSTN all strongly enriched over other cells. Plasma cell signal is present as a moderate foreign-lineage component (M3 IgG plasma cell 3.3%, M31 plasma cell Ig program 0.6%, IGHG1 1.6% among top genes), likely in a minority of cells, and is contamination rather than the cluster's identity; B cell (M34) and myeloid (M14, M59) signal is minor. Squamous (M37) signal at 4.5% is small.
metagene_label: Fibroblast ECM markers + Activated fibroblasts, ECM-remodeling

label: Squamous epithelium/stroma mixture (low confidence)
description: Tiny, low-confidence cluster with no dominant lineage. The largest shares are squamous differentiation M37 (6.7%, FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, SCEL, 10x fold, but only in about 10% of cells) and stromal signal from smooth muscle M19 (6.5%), fibroblast ECM M4 (4.9%) and stromal stress M75 (3.1%), with genes such as SFRP4, COL3A1, CCN2 and TAGLN. Small Treg M83 (4.7%) and CD8 cytotoxic M93 (2.6%) shares are likely background from the few cells involved. Most of the remaining signal is diffuse housekeeping metagenes (M89, M98, M58, M72, M64, M99, M84), which carry no identity.
cell_types: Squamous epithelial cells, Fibroblasts, Smooth muscle cells
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation, inflamed + Smooth muscle / myofibroblast stroma

label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (inflamed)
description: Small cluster (32 cells) dominated by squamous differentiation signal: M37 (7.5% share, 11.6x fold, cornification genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL) together with M15 (cornification genes IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KLK10) and M6 and M0 (squamous keratins and desmosomal genes, KRT13, DSG3, DSC2). Top genes ERO1A, IVL, CRNN and FLG agree. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent, so the cells look superficial or inflamed rather than basal. Fibroblast M4 (3.5%) and lymphoid M79 (9%, low confidence) are weak and below contamination thresholds. IGHG1 is among top genes but has no supporting lineage metagene, so it is not used.
refine_reason: Same inflamed differentiated squamous identity as clusters 22 and 31; wording standardized.

label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells (inflamed)
description: Cluster 31 is a small (30 cells) population of differentiated squamous epithelial cells. M37 (squamous differentiation, inflamed; FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, KRT13, IL36A) carries the largest share at 12.4%, supported by cornification genes in M15 (IVL, SBSN, TGM1, KRTDAP, KLK7), and the top genes are dominated by FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL, and IL36A. Foreign signal is modest and likely doublet or spillover: T cells (M29, 7.2%), fibroblasts (M4, 6.2%, diffuse across cells), and IgG plasma cells (M3, 1.6%) are each under 10%. Basal markers are absent, so the cells look superficial rather than basal.
metagene_label: Squamous differentiation, inflamed + T cell markers

label: Differentiated squamous epithelial cells
description: Cluster 32 is a small group of 33 cells whose only clear identity signal is squamous differentiation. M37 (6.2% share, fold 9.5x, in 12% of cells) carries the top genes FLG, CRNN, CRCT1, IVL and KRT13, pointing to superficial, granular-layer keratinizing epithelium, though it is mixed with inflammatory (S100A8) and hypoxia (ERO1A) genes. Basal markers KRT5 and KRT14 are absent. M29 (T cell markers, 4.1% share, in 12% of cells) is below the contamination threshold and is treated as background, with no CD3 genes among the top genes. The remaining metagenes are diffuse, low-specificity background factors (M45, M50, M58 and others) that do not define an identity. Confidence is medium because the cluster is tiny and the squamous signal is moderate.

label: Activated fibroblasts, ECM-remodeling
description: Cluster 33 is a small fibroblast population (119 cells, 0.2%) dominated by the fibroblast ECM core metagene M4 (42.3% of counts, in 92% of cells, 18.9x fold), with top genes COL3A1, SFRP4, SFRP1, COL6A1/2, COL5A1/2, LUM, TNC, PDGFRA and COL1A2 all strongly enriched. The activated/cancer-associated fibroblast factor M38 (13.2%, 45% of cells, 16.8x) adds POSTN, INHBA, MMP11 and THBS2, pointing to an ECM-remodeling activated fibroblast state. Smooth muscle (M19, 5.6%) and myeloid (M14, 1.3%) signals are minor and do not indicate a mixture; the diffuse ambiguous metagenes are background.

label: Activated fibroblasts (smooth muscle-like stroma)
description: Stromal cluster with fibroblast-core ECM signal: M4 (fibroblast ECM markers, 5.3% share, fold 2.4x) and M38 (activated ECM-remodeling fibroblasts, 2.5%) are supported by top genes COL3A1, COL6A1, COL5A1, SFRP1, SFRP4, AEBP1 and CCN2. Smooth muscle contractile signal from M19 (6.1%, fold 4.0x; TAGLN, DES, ACTG2, MYLK) is also present, so the cluster leans toward activated, smooth muscle-like stroma. M25 (pericyte-like) adds a minor stromal component. Squamous (M37, 4.1%) and other epithelial-like signals are small and treated as background. Most of the remaining shares come from diffuse, ambiguous metagenes (M64, M60, M45, M56, M91, M30, M61, M66, M97), which carry no lineage identity.
refine_reason: Same smooth muscle-like activated stroma identity as cluster 7; wording aligned.

label: Squamous epithelial cells (inflamed, superficial)
